workouts.name: Full Body Starter
workouts.description: Latihan seluruh tubuh tanpa alat untuk pemula.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.instruction: Lompat sambil membuka kaki dan mengangkat kedua tangan.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instruction: Turunkan pinggul seperti duduk, punggung tetap lurus.

exercises.name: Knee Push Up
exercises.instruction: Tumpukan lutut di lantai, turunkan dada perlahan.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instruction: Berbaring, angkat pinggul hingga lurus, tahan 1 detik.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instruction: Tahan posisi papan, perut kencang, pinggul sejajar.

exercises.name: Neck Roll
exercises.instruction: Putar kepala perlahan searah jarum jam lalu sebaliknya.

exercises.name: Arm Circle
exercises.instruction: Putar kedua lengan ke depan lalu ke belakang.

exercises.name: Cat Cow
exercises.instruction: Posisi merangkak, lengkungkan dan tekuk punggung bergantian.

exercises.name: Hip Opener
exercises.instruction: Posisi lunge rendah, tahan dan rasakan regangan.

exercises.name: Wall Push Up
exercises.instruction: Berdiri satu langkah dari dinding, dorong badan perlahan.

exercises.name: Shoulder Tap
exercises.instruction: Posisi plank, sentuh bahu bergantian tanpa menggoyang pinggul.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.instruction: Tengkurap, angkat dada dan kaki bersamaan, tahan.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip (kursi)
exercises.instruction: Bertumpu di tepi kursi, turunkan siku hingga 90 derajat.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instruction: Pegang dumbbell/botol air di dada, squat hingga paha sejajar.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instruction: Melangkah panjang, lutut belakang hampir menyentuh lantai.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instruction: Dorong pinggul ke belakang, punggung netral, beban dekat kaki.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.instruction: Berjinjit perlahan, tahan 1 detik di puncak.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.instruction: Sandarkan punggung ke dinding, lutut 90 derajat.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.instruction: Angkat bahu dari lantai, jangan tarik leher.

exercises.name: Leg Raise
exercises.instruction: Angkat kedua kaki lurus, turunkan tanpa menyentuh lantai.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instruction: Duduk condong, putar badan ke kiri dan kanan.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instruction: Tahan plank menyamping, pinggul terangkat.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.instruction: Posisi plank, tarik lutut bergantian dengan cepat.

workouts.name: HIIT Fat Burn
workouts.description: Interval intensitas tinggi untuk membakar kalori.

exercises.name: High Knee
exercises.instruction: Lari di tempat sambil mengangkat lutut setinggi pinggang.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.instruction: Squat, plank, push up, lalu lompat ke atas.

exercises.name: Skater Jump
exercises.instruction: Lompat menyamping bergantian seperti pemain skate.

exercises.name: Squat Jump
exercises.instruction: Squat lalu lompat setinggi mungkin, mendarat lembut.

exercises.name: Brisk Walk
exercises.instruction: Jaga ritme napas, langkah panjang dan konsisten.

exercises.name: Light Jog
exercises.instruction: Pertahankan kecepatan di mana masih bisa berbicara.

exercises.name: Cool Down Walk
exercises.instruction: Turunkan kecepatan perlahan selama 5 menit.

workouts.name: Strength Push
workouts.description: Dorongan berat untuk dada, bahu, trisep.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instruction: Turunkan bar ke dada, dorong hingga siku lurus.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instruction: Dorong beban lurus ke atas kepala, core terkunci.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instruction: Bangku miring 30 derajat, dorong dumbbell ke atas.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.instruction: Turunkan badan terkontrol, jangan terlalu dalam.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instruction: Angkat dumbbell ke samping hingga sejajar bahu.

workouts.name: Strength Pull
workouts.description: Tarikan berat untuk punggung dan bisep.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instruction: Punggung netral, dorong lantai dengan kaki, bar dekat tubuh.

exercises.name: Pull Up
exercises.instruction: Tarik dagu melewati bar, turun terkontrol.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instruction: Condong 45 derajat, tarik bar ke perut bawah.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instruction: Tarik tali ke arah wajah, siku tinggi.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instruction: Angkat bar tanpa mengayun badan.

workouts.name: Advanced Full Body
workouts.description: Sirkuit padat untuk yang sudah terlatih.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instruction: Bar di depan bahu, siku tinggi, squat dalam.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull Up
exercises.instruction: Tambahkan beban, tarik dagu melewati bar.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instruction: Kaki belakang di bangku, turunkan lutut depan 90 derajat.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.instruction: Gunakan dorongan kaki untuk mendorong bar ke atas.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instruction: Gantung di bar, angkat kaki lurus hingga pinggang.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.instruction: Jalan membawa beban berat di kedua tangan, badan tegak.

exercises.name: Chair Squat
exercises.instruction: Berdiri dan duduk dari kursi tanpa menggunakan tangan.

exercises.name: Desk Push Up
exercises.instruction: Bertumpu di meja kokoh, turunkan dada perlahan.

exercises.name: Seated Knee Tuck
exercises.instruction: Duduk di tepi kursi, tarik kedua lutut ke dada.

exercises.name: Standing Stretch
exercises.instruction: Angkat kedua tangan, regangkan badan ke samping.

exercises.name: Child Pose
exercises.instruction: Duduk di tumit, julurkan tangan ke depan, napas dalam.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.instruction: Duduk, raih ujung kaki tanpa membungkukkan punggung.

exercises.name: Figure Four Stretch
exercises.instruction: Berbaring, silangkan pergelangan di lutut, tarik paha.

exercises.name: Deep Breathing
exercises.instruction: Tarik napas 4 detik, tahan 4, hembus 6 detik.
